status: expectations drafted 2026-09-14 from the corpus text; to be confirmed by the author before the live recording

cases.question: Qual é o objetivo da avaliação interna de risco prevista na Circular 3.978?
cases.why: Art. 10 states it: identify and measure the risk of the institution's products and services being used for ML/TF.

cases.question: Em que prazo a comunicação de operação suspeita deve ser feita ao Coaf?
cases.why: Art. 48, § 2º: until the business day following the decision to communicate.

cases.question: Depósitos em espécie atípicos em relação à atividade econômica do cliente são indício de suspeita segundo a Carta Circular 4.001?
cases.why: Art. 1º, I, a) of Carta Circular 4.001 lists exactly that; the unit is art. 1º, caput (its incisos and alíneas nest under it).

cases.question: Quando a Circular 3.978 entra em vigor?
cases.why: The demonstration case. Consolidated art. 70 says 1º/10/2020 (Circular 4.005); the original said 1º/7/2020 and may be mentioned as history, never alone.

cases.question: A identificação de cliente pessoa jurídica exige o endereço da sede?
cases.why: Consolidated art. 16, § 2º, II (Resolução BCB 119/2021) requires firma/denominação and CNPJ only; the original required the address. An answer from the original would say yes.

cases.question: O que o texto original da Circular 3.978 previa como data de entrada em vigor?
cases.why: Legitimately about the original; the contract still requires the version in force to be cited alongside.

cases.question: Quais procedimentos devem ser adotados na compra de ouro?
cases.why: The corpus has red-flag situations around the gold market (4.001, art. 1º, XIX, under the art. 1º unit); purchase procedures are in IN BCB 406/2023, outside the corpus. The showcase of the third outcome.

cases.question: O que a Resolução BCB 344 mudou na Circular 3.978?
cases.why: The consolidated marker on art. 23-A says it was included by Resolução 344; the amending act's own text is in the corpus but not indexed. The corpus contains the act, not its diff.

cases.question: Qual é a pena para o crime de lavagem de dinheiro?
cases.why: Lei 9.613/1998 is federal law, not a BCB act; the corpus regulates institutions, not the crime.

cases.question: Qual o prazo para uma joalheria comunicar operações suspeitas ao Coaf?
cases.why: Jewellers are COAF-regulated, not BCB-supervised; the deadline in the corpus (art. 48, § 2º) is for BCB institutions and must not be transplanted.

cases.question: Qual é a multa por descumprir a Circular 3.978?
cases.why: Penalties are in Resolução BCB 131/2021, outside the corpus.

cases.question: Qual é o prazo?
cases.why: Prazo for what? The corpus has several; the ambiguity must be named.

cases.question: O que diz o art. 4º?
cases.why: Art. 4º of which act? Both 3.978 and 3.461 have one, on different subjects.

cases.question: O que a Circular 3.461 dizia sobre pessoas expostas politicamente?
cases.why: Answerable from the revoked text, provided the revocation by Circular 3.978 (from 1º/10/2020) is stated and its notice cited — the contract's revoked_without_notice rule.

cases.question: Quais informações cadastrais a Circular 3.461 exige dos clientes?
cases.why: Present tense about a revoked act: the trap is answering as if it were in force. Any outcome that states the revocation and cites the notice passes; a silent answer fails.
